responsibility: Defines the core target-machine configuration macros for GCC’s MCore port. It establishes preprocessor builtins, default ABI and endianness settings, storage layout and alignment rules, register file numbering and classes, calling and stack conventions, addressing and constant-handling policies, assembler syntax and section directives, symbol emission behavior, and the target macro bindings that connect generic GCC backend machinery to MCore-specific helpers in mcore.cc and optional ELF overlays in mcore-elf.h.
same_name_distinction: Target configuration header for the MCore port: it declares macros, ABI/layout constants, register and assembler interface definitions, and bindings to helpers implemented in mcore.cc, instead of containing executable backend logic like mcore.cc, instruction patterns like mcore.md, or user option records like mcore.opt.
